envelope.description: Carry the script in the three page shells

body.title: Carry the script in the three page shells
body.summary: Import CODE_REF_SCRIPT into the companion page shell (src/workflow/artifacts/companion/shell.ts), the docgen Mermaid shell (src/docgen/render/shell.ts) and the docgen subprocess fallback (assembleFallbackShell in src/docgen/render/fallback.ts) and inline it. The two Mermaid shells run the marking after mermaid.run resolves, and a page with no Mermaid visual and the fallback run it once at load. A marked element gets a pointer cursor from the page's own style.
acceptanceChecks: The companion shell, the docgen Mermaid shell and the docgen fallback shell each carry CODE_REF_SCRIPT, imported from the one module, with no import cycle between the shells and the module
In the two Mermaid shells the marking runs after the diagram is drawn; a page with no Mermaid visual and the fallback mark references at load
A marked element is styled as clickable (a pointer cursor) in the companion shell and in both docgen shells
A page built without any reference is otherwise unchanged and still renders its header, narrative, view and description tables

tests.name: src/workflow/artifacts/companion/__tests__/code-ref-script.test.ts: the companion page and the docgen page carry the script, after the diagram is drawn
